</svg>'''

    <section class="section cover-hero" style="padding-top:90px; border-top:none; grid-template-columns:1fr; max-width:1180px;">
      <div class="episode-title" style="max-width:1080px;">
        <p class="eyebrow">EPISODE #50 · MYTHS &amp; LEGENDS</p>
        <h1>Bifrost</h1>
        <p class="episode-question">What happens when the bridge is reusable, but every crossing must be powered?</p>
        <div class="metric"><span class="metric-value">120.3 kg CO₂e</span><span class="metric-label">one controlled Bifrost activation enabling a 10-minute crossing window for one expedition transfer</span></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section split">
      <div><p class="eyebrow">THE SUBJECT</p><h2>The bridge burns before it carries.</h2></div>
      <div class="prose">
        <p>The approved reconstruction treats Bifrost as a reusable two-gate light-bridge apparatus: a 1,200 m visible corridor with a 3.0 m walkable band, basalt plinths, bronze rings, emerald prism lenses, three translucent corridor bands and a red-orange thermal exclusion strand.</p>
        <p>The functional event is one controlled activation lasting ten minutes. Operating energy stabilizes the light corridor, maintains the red fire-guard, runs gate controls and cools the system. Gate infrastructure is not rebuilt at every crossing; its materials are amortized across a 10,000-activation design life.</p>
        <p>The boundary includes gate activation electricity, fire-guard energy, control and cooling, allocated gate materials and maintenance logistics. Realm creation, divine labour, traveller biology, avoided travel and Ragnarok collapse are excluded. Magic distance remains outside the modeled physical system.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section episode-quickfacts">
      <div class="quickfact"><span>01</span><h3>1,200 m × 3.0 m</h3><p>A visible light-bridge corridor between two reusable gate pylons.</p></div>
      <div class="quickfact"><span>02</span><h3>621.0 kWh</h3><p>Total electricity per activation at a composite factor of 0.18436 kg CO₂e/kWh.</p></div>
      <div class="quickfact"><span>03</span><h3>95.2% electricity</h3><p>The baseline is operational: materials are only 4.6% after amortization.</p></div>
      <div class="quickfact"><span>04</span><h3>Fire-guard uncertainty</h3><p>The red strand is the largest single modeled flow at 73.7 kg CO₂e and drives the widest physical sensitivity.</p></div>
    </section>

    <section class="section episode-visual-section">
      <div class="section-heading visual-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">VISUAL MODEL</p><h2>From reusable gates to one powered crossing</h2></div><p class="section-note">The graphics reproduce only the physical reconstruction, modeled flows and exclusions stated in the approved episode.</p></div>
